content.short: No-code on-chain governance platform used by Optimism, Uniswap, ENS, Scroll and ether.fi.
content.description: Agora runs the voting portals behind some of the largest DAOs, including vote.optimism.io, agora.ensdao.org and Uniswap's delegate portal, plus governance for Scroll, Derive and ether.fi. Protocols deploy proposals, delegation and voting without writing contracts. Its work with Optimism introduced new voting mechanisms, and a Uniswap campaign moved more than 8 million UNI to active delegates. Agora also built World Vote, a pilot of verified one-person voting with World ID.
content.meta: Agora powers DAO voting for Optimism, Uniswap, ENS and ether.fi, and built World Vote for verified voting in World App.
